overall_summary: All historical videos currently have single-digit or very low double-digit views with zero engagement, indicating that confidence is extremely low and the channel is in an early testing phase. Content focused on personal boundaries and digital reminders (like chats and phone notes) performed marginally better.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video AfaLxMy6FMY ('self respect', hook: 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी') got the highest views (24).
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate themes dealing with taking action on chats, blocks, or choosing self-respect over lingering.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract or generic late-night atmospheric hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') and zL8saHvD-uI ('टाइपिंग... लिखकर फिर से डिलीट कर दिया') received very low views (4-5).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly poetic or slow-burn atmospheric openings; start with an active, highly concrete micro-decision.

next_video.concept: A person goes to check if they are still blocked, realizes they finally aren't, but closes the app anyway because it doesn't matter anymore.
next_video.opening_direction: आज उसने खुद अनब्लॉक कर दिया,
next_video.twist_direction: पर मैंने सर्च बार में उसका नाम टाइप करना बंद कर दिया है।
next_video.reason: Building on the slight positive traction of the 'self respect' and digital interaction theme while tightening the narrative arc to create a stronger emotional turnaround.

experiment: Testing an active behavior-shifting hook ('unblocked') combined with self-respect closure versus passive waiting hooks.
